title: At School
introduction: Practise at school with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Use classroom words to name, identify and describe objects at school.
rules: Ask a partner what an object is.
Say: I sit at my desk.
Say: We read in the library.
Say: My classmate has a ruler.
Say: I put my notebook in my schoolbag.
Say: The pupils eat in the canteen.
Say: We play in the playground.
Say: The timetable is on the board.

vocabulary.description: A place with books to read or borrow.
A place to buy or eat meals at school.
A book used to study a subject.
A container for pens and pencils.
A tool for removing pencil marks.
A pen for making clear marks.
A book or resource explaining words.
A list showing when lessons happen.
A gathering of pupils and teachers.

examples.question: Read and say this sentence.
steps: I put my notebook in my schoolbag.
examples.answer: I put my notebook in my schoolbag.

examples.question: Read and say this sentence.
steps: The pupils eat in the canteen.
examples.answer: The pupils eat in the canteen.

examples.question: Read and say this sentence.
steps: The timetable is on the board.
examples.answer: The timetable is on the board.

exercises.question: Where can you borrow books?
exercises.solution: A library lends books to readers.

exercises.question: Where can pupils buy lunch?
exercises.solution: A canteen is a place where pupils can buy food.

exercises.question: Who teaches a class?
exercises.solution: A teacher helps pupils learn in class.

exercises.question: What shows lesson times?
exercises.solution: A timetable lists lessons and their times.

exercises.question: What sharpens pencils?
exercises.solution: A sharpener makes a pencil point sharp.

exercises.question: What holds pens and pencils?
exercises.solution: A pencil case holds writing tools.

exercises.question: What is a book of exercises?
exercises.solution: A workbook contains activities and exercises.

exercises.question: Where can children play at school?
exercises.solution: A playground is an area for play.

exercises.question: Complete: This ___ my notebook.
exercises.solution: Use is with this to identify one thing.

exercises.question: Complete: There are two ___. (desks or desk)
exercises.solution: Two requires a plural noun; add s to desk.

exercises.question: What is a person in your class called?
exercises.solution: A classmate is someone in the same class.

summary: Use classroom words to name, identify and describe objects at school.
